figures.caption: Figure 1: Illustration of the Contextual Language-Informed Cardiac pathology classification (CLIC) framework. The framework consists of two input data workflows: a Resnet18 that receives a 12-lead ECG as input, and a ClinicalBERT that receives a contextual clinical text generated via a templatebased strategy called Data-to-text (1) and a Prompt-guided strategy that uses Llama (2).
Figure 2: UMAP visualization of embedding distributions across models.
